author: Mark Atwood
text: Update (round 4): the sync loop is ALIVE and actively draining the worker queue — at 20:58 it is mid-merge of worker7 (MERGE_HEAD 75fab2c8f5) with a live janitor resolving a .beads/counter.json conflict. So the merge mechanism works; worker5 is simply still 644 behind awaiting its turn in the queue. I cannot rebase from this checkout without corrupting the in-flight worker7 merge, and all remaining sync-script beads (nm0h/0mqr/thni/840r) target post-merge-base code (snapshot_store/normalize_merge_store_entries/d42k pin) absent from this branch. Worker5 will become workable once the loop merges it. No worker-side action available this round; yielding to the sync loop. Recommend Mark confirm the loop eventually processes worker5 (it has 5 unmerged commits incl. the gpm7 fix).
